lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-intensity white circular spots arranged in a staggered grid on the mid-lateral flank, bounded by the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of light blue/white intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid where spots are centered within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges running parallel to the longitudinal axis on the upper flank, showing a clear luminance gradient with highlight on top and shadow beneath.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 low-intensity, light-colored spots visible on the lower and central portions of the dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct elongated fish silhouettes (remoras) located ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin area.
